summary: Strada is a private contact management application that uses Postgres row-level security to enforce data ownership. The project features a React frontend and an Express backend, with an optional local wiki-sync tool for Obsidian vaults.
key_facts: Strada is a private record of people to stay close to, behaving like a record rather than a queue.
The application uses React 19, Vite, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS v4 for the frontend.
The backend is built with Express 5 and TypeScript (ESM) and is deployed on Vercel.
The database is Neon Postgres with Row Level Security (RLS) enforced on the contacts table.
Authentication is handled via Neon Managed Better Auth using Ed25519 JWTs.
188 automated tests: 163 hermetic (npm test) and 25 live (npm run test:rls) covering the two-account privacy proof and the wiki-layer lock.
The project includes an optional local wiki-sync tool that populates Strada from an Obsidian vault.
The application supports light, dark, and system themes.

concepts.name: Row Level Security
concepts.definition: A database security mechanism that restricts data access based on the user's identity.
concepts.in_this_source: The project uses Postgres RLS to enforce ownership of contacts, ensuring users can only access their own rows.

concepts.name: Ed25519 JWT
concepts.definition: A type of JSON Web Token using the EdDSA signature algorithm.
concepts.in_this_source: The application uses Ed25519 JWTs issued by Neon Managed Better Auth for authentication.

concepts.name: Neon Data API
concepts.definition: Neon's PostgREST-based HTTP interface to a Postgres database, called with the end user's own JWT.
concepts.in_this_source: The Express API has no Postgres driver or DATABASE_URL; it reaches the database only through the Data API with the user's own token, so RLS scopes every query.

concepts.name: Neon Postgres
concepts.in_this_source: The project uses Neon Postgres as its primary database.

concepts.name: Vercel
concepts.definition: A cloud platform for hosting web applications and serverless functions.
concepts.in_this_source: The project is deployed on Vercel using two separate projects for the frontend and backend.
